verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud's pricing page lists forecasting features: "Sales Quoting and Forecasting", "Predictive Forecasting" and "Advanced Forecast & Pipeline Management". The CRM page also names forecasting as a built-in capability alongside pipeline visibility. However, this evidence is only feature-list labels with no detail on how forecasts are calculated. Missing for 10: documentation that forecasts use pipeline value, stage probabilities and close dates, detail on forecast mechanics, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
